# FastAPI网关最小服务桩代码

下面为你输出 **FastAPI 网关最小服务桩代码**，用于本地调试上面的 Python SDK，仅做模拟服务端，不接入真实元极恒一内核逻辑。

保存文件：`meta_gateway_stub.py`

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List
import uuid

app = FastAPI(title="元极恒一网关‑模拟桩服务")

# 内存模拟存储
ws_store: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
task_store: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
paradigm_store: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

# 请求模型
class WorkspaceForkRequest(BaseModel):
    domain_type: str
    load_paradigm_ids: Optional[List[str]] = None
    expire_policy: str = "frozen_after_complete"
    external_meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

class TaskSubmitRequest(BaseModel):
    workspace_handle: str
    task_payload: Dict[str, Any]
    enable_drift_monitor: bool = True
    require_archive: bool = True

class CredentialVerifyRequest(BaseModel):
    merkle_root: str
    task_t_chain_id: str

class WorkspaceArchiveRequest(BaseModel):
    workspace_handle: str
    archive_mode: str = "cold_base85"

class ParadigmRegisterRequest(BaseModel):
    paradigm_content: Dict[str, Any]
    paradigm_signature: str

@app.post("/v1/meta/workspace/fork")
def workspace_fork(req: WorkspaceForkRequest):
    ws_handle = f"WS‑{uuid.uuid4()}"
    init_snap = f"sha256‑stub‑{uuid.uuid4()}"
    ws_store[ws_handle] = {
        "domain_type": req.domain_type,
        "init_merkle_snapshot": init_snap,
        "status": "active"
    }
    return {
        "code":0,
        "workspace_handle": ws_handle,
        "init_merkle_snapshot": init_snap,
        "msg":"workspace fork success, baseline from ZONGYUAN‑ROOT"
    }

@app.post("/v1/meta/task/submit")
def task_submit(req: TaskSubmitRequest):
    if req.workspace_handle not in ws_store:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="workspace_handle不存在")
    task_id = f"TASK‑{uuid.uuid4()}"
    task_store[task_id] = {
        "status":"completed",
        "workspace_handle": req.workspace_handle,
        "final_truth_output":{"result":"模拟推演输出结果"},
        "audit_credential":{
            "merkle_root":f"0x{uuid.uuid4()}",
            "task_t_chain_id":f"T‑STUB‑{uuid.uuid4()}",
            "snap_sha256":f"sha256‑{uuid.uuid4()}",
            "domain_type": ws_store[req.workspace_handle]["domain_type"],
            "drift_degenerate_score":0.08
        },
        "draft_access_token":""
    }
    return {
        "code":0,
        "task_id":task_id,
        "status":"running",
        "task_accept_timestamp":1787921111
    }

@app.get("/v1/meta/task/result")
def task_result(task_id:str):
    t = task_store.get(task_id)
    if not t:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="task不存在")
    return {
        "code":0,
        "task_id":task_id,
        "status":t["status"],
        "final_truth_output":t["final_truth_output"],
        "audit_credential":t["audit_credential"],
        "draft_access_token":t["draft_access_token"]
    }

@app.post("/v1/meta/credential/verify")
def credential_verify(req: CredentialVerifyRequest):
    return {
        "code":0,
        "valid":True,
        "credential_meta":{"note":"模拟凭证校验通过"}
    }

@app.post("/v1/meta/workspace/archive")
def workspace_archive(req: WorkspaceArchiveRequest):
    if req.workspace_handle not in ws_store:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="workspace不存在")
    cred_id = f"CRED‑{uuid.uuid4()}"
    return {"code":0,"credential_id":cred_id}

@app.post("/v1/meta/paradigm/register")
def paradigm_register(req: ParadigmRegisterRequest):
    pid = f"PARAD‑{uuid.uuid4()}"
    paradigm_store[pid] = {"content":req.paradigm_content}
    return {"code":0,"paradigm_id":pid}
```

### 运行方式

1. 安装依赖

```bash
pip install fastapi uvicorn requests
```

1. 启动桩服务

```bash
uvicorn meta_gateway_stub:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
```

1. 修改 SDK 中`GATEWAY_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1"`，即可本地跑通整套调用链路。

> 全域锁档归档：快照 SNAP‑GATEWAY‑STUB‑001，写入 Merkle 谱系挂载 ZONGYUAN‑ROOT，DID‑BR‑000002。

这个是接口网关相关的服务代码，工作任务模式可以更好地完成接口服务的开发调试，要不要使用？
